nodes.label: OpenRouter shootout (blocked at stage 1)
nodes.rationale: The fidelity arm gates everything: it failed to produce a plan at all, so testing three more models under the same broken configuration would produce numbers that look like a comparison but are not one — a confident wrong answer is worse than no answer.

nodes.label: Same-model-both-transports fidelity control arm
nodes.rationale: Without it a candidate number cannot be attributed between the model and this branch's OpenRouter adapter; it was later dropped by explicit user instruction rather than fixed, permanently weakening every subsequent arm.

nodes.label: Adapter bug 2a: strip bound keywords from the strict wire schema
nodes.rationale: OpenRouter's strict validator rejects maxItems/minItems/maximum/minimum/propertyNames one at a time; safeParse still enforces every bound on the response, so stripping drops only a wire hint the vendor cannot accept.

nodes.label: Adapter bug 2b: assistant-turn replay nested the whole message
nodes.rationale: assistantTurn.content is deliberately the whole raw message so a repair round replays it verbatim; spreading it into the wire messages array wrapped it inside another message's content, which OpenRouter rejects — cost ~340s of generation before the 400.

nodes.label: Shared 32,000-token completion ceiling
nodes.rationale: Deliberately NOT raised inside the shootout: it is a cost/latency policy change affecting every production run on both transports, and this codebase's own medium/high reversal is the argument for measuring such a change on its own rather than fixing it to make the shootout's gate pass.

nodes.label: Corrupted ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (U+2192 in the value)
nodes.rationale: The SDK throws building the auth header before any network call; no repair was attempted because guessing at a corrupted secret risks silently using the wrong credential and the key must never be printed.

nodes.label: Harness env key-parser bug (trailing inline comment)
nodes.rationale: loadEnvKeyIfAbsent matched ^NAME=(.+)$ and swallowed a trailing comment into the value; the real cause of §4's apparent key corruption, fixed with a regression test asserting length 108 and pure ASCII without printing the key.

nodes.label: bracket-16 hard pack
nodes.rationale: Built specifically to exercise H6 feed ordering and H4 shared-person overlap under tight capacity — real feeds.after chains, 4 shared people, 2 courts, 5.5h window, one blackout, one pinned fixture.

nodes.label: Cold-start draft defect in the synthetic packs
nodes.rationale: Every synthetic pack shipped draft: [] so the model had to cold-build from nothing, a strictly harder task than production ever runs; the gap bites hardest on bracket-16 where a legal starting point is worth the most, and the earlier hard-pack failures were this artifact, not the models.

nodes.label: withGreedyDraft(pack) post-processor
nodes.rationale: Runs the same slotFixtures + toSlotConfig as production so bench packs carry a production-shaped draft; trap fixed along the way — synthetic packs have no startAt, so seeding now from 0 would put the 365-day horizon in 1971 and place nothing, re-creating the empty draft.

nodes.label: grok-4.5 reliability finding (1 clean / 3 on bracket-16)
nodes.rationale: Its scheduling capability is not in doubt (the one clean run placed 14/14) but it runs 500–600s right against the round-timeout wall with two independent failure modes — unparsable response body and timeout — 6–9x slower than gemini on the identical pack.

nodes.label: gemini-3.6-flash as the clean cheap fast candidate
nodes.rationale: 2/2 clean on bracket-16 with the realistic draft, ~$0.18 and ~80s mean, comfortably under ceiling — the only candidate that is both correct and reliable on the hard pack.

nodes.label: 'Clean' means 0 blocking AND 0 warnings
nodes.rationale: Cheap tiers stay legal while ignoring soft constraints, so 0 blocking alone is never called a pass — warnings are reported at the same prominence as blocking.

nodes.label: usage.output_tokens is cumulative across a run
nodes.rationale: A row can exceed 100% of the per-call ceiling because rounds:0 means zero repair rounds but cannot distinguish an internal corrective retry after truncation; AiChatResponse exposes neither finish_reason nor a per-call breakdown.

nodes.label: probeServedProvider finish_reason is a probe artifact
nodes.rationale: The isolated sanity call caps max_tokens at 8, and some models spend part of even that on reasoning — its finish_reason says nothing about the real bench round, whose cleanliness is inferred from rounds:0 plus a schema-valid parsed plan.

nodes.label: openrouter-policy.ts ALLOWED_PROVIDERS allowlist
nodes.rationale: Narrowed to exactly the vendors being pursued; widening it is a customer-facing promise change because the help pages must name every vendor, so an allowlist widen is not complete until those pages are updated.

nodes.label: Fallback ladder gemini → sonnet → grok
nodes.rationale: gemini is the cheap/fast primary, sonnet-direct the proven backstop, and grok is last deliberately — putting it ahead of sonnet would make a gemini miss wait through grok's ~10-minute timeout risk before reaching the model that works every time.

nodes.label: runLadder (N-rung generic ladder)
nodes.rationale: Generalises the 2-model cheap→primary escalation; each rung pins its own provider via resolveProvider rather than mutating the process-global AI_PROVIDER, which is unsafe under concurrent requests. Unconfigured rungs are skipped, so setting OPENROUTER_API_KEY IS the production flip.

nodes.label: Ladder advance trigger (recoverable failures + warning flood)
nodes.rationale: Advance on AI_PLAN_FAILED, AI_PLAN_TIMEOUT, AiProviderError or a warning-flooded plan; never on a deterministic user error, which fails identically on every rung so retrying only burns money.

nodes.label: Null-preserving cross-rung cost accounting
nodes.rationale: Provider-reported cost first with estimate only as fallback and unknown never collapsing to 0; usage from every rung tried is summed and the ledger stamps the model that actually served plus rungs_tried, so even a total failure is metered against the truth.

hyperedges.label: OpenRouter transport defects that contaminated the shootout
